roles.slot_rules: Every listed role declared exactly once, actual or missing; actual tuple follows nonmissing-role order and exact manifest/batch bijection. Unique actual input_id. Original complete actual metadata of every supplied batch in result inputs, including excluded facts. Prior-complete period declares bars missing; no target bars consumed. Shared physical BAR path/open witness uses one path role. No new DataKind, hidden context facts, closure or DTO transport.

frozen_context_encoding: ASCII JSON ensure_ascii=true, sort_keys=true, separators comma/colon without whitespace, allow_nan=false; compare exact reencoded bytes; reject duplicates, unknown fields, noncanonical integers, unsafe strings and bool-as-int

frozen_config_reconstruction.window: WindowSpec count=number of context calendar sessions, target actual target ID, governed_sessions exact context session IDs, anchor completed_eod; when calendar null use count1,target-only governed IDs. EF1 does not invoke legacy selected_sessions to derive its period population.
frozen_config_reconstruction.price_unit: exact caller-declared canonical unit; mandatory for price/notional producers; nullable only clock/status/classification assessments
frozen_config_reconstruction.adjustment: exact declared requested canonical adjustment; actual market bindings remain separately retained and checked
frozen_config_reconstruction.digest: reconstruct exact public ConfigSpec and compare full digest; worker must never replace result digest/input bindings

frozen_closed_reference_mapping.identity_encoding: B is reversible canonical UTF8 base64url without padding. Combined reference_id<=128codepoints/512UTF8bytes; reject overflow/noncanonical encoding, never truncate or replace IDs with fabricated order.
frozen_closed_reference_mapping.source_relation: Every proof relation names actual target input_id P and matches actual namespace/entity/source.source_id/source.snapshot_id; proofs and facts have distinct actual input_ids. Cross-source attestations unsupported. Mapping version per role must match explicit ef1-reference-map1 conversion. This validates declarations, not authenticated acquisition.

status_state.sequence: 19digit zero-padded nonnegative int64; strict increase, effective time nondecreasing; equal time tie by sequence; numeric sequence gaps alone do not prove missing messages

status_prefix.interval: positive finite [start,end), start<=seed original effective time and C<=end; original known_at<=K; complete supplied proof population

status_validity.interval: positive finite [start,end), start<=C<end; original known_at<=K; complete proof population; distinct dedicated batch permits same certificate ID in different proof kinds

frozen_closed_reference_mapping.unused_fields: Proof/status/classification rows have no price/factor payload; source factor rows have exact positive factor_num/den, no text/price and no finite effective_end; no JSON payloads. Calendar/anchor hash grammars are disjoint by fact_kind/role from action a1 relation grammar.
frozen_closed_reference_mapping.canonical_order: All REFERENCE rows already ordered by effective_start_ns,reference_id; no producer/worker sorting. Status semantic sequence/epoch checks additional to canonical validation.

frozen_quality_projection.normal: existing Status/Reason only; malformed schema/order/unit/basis/overflow typed ContractError before any result
frozen_quality_projection.all_visible_reasons: Retain all independently applicable existing reasons in fixed lexical order; status precedence above chooses one status. No new gate reason inserted into legacy Reason enum.
frozen_quality_projection.status_max_age: Explicit max reject -> state null, missing_input/ineligible, admission unavailable/stale_state. Proven descriptive age remains available. No selected max -> no event-age expiry.
frozen_quality_projection.status_unknown: Unknown seed/prefix/validity/required transition -> state and current-state age null with original missing/coverage/knowledge reason; no last-observed-age fallback. Finite state/validity expiry -> missing_input/ineligible.
frozen_quality_projection.assessment: State/reason diagnostic outputs available with expected=observed=1 for a completed evaluation, even outcome unknown/failed. That is assessment readiness, not factual readiness. All source input bindings and excluded original facts retained.
frozen_quality_projection.classification_value: Passed gate -> actual selected nonblank membership text available; proved absence -> null/not_applicable/no_eligible_observations; missing proof/population or late/unknown fact -> null with applicable missing-input reason; partial projection -> null/incomplete_coverage/governed_gap; known mismatch -> null/missing_input/ineligible.
frozen_quality_projection.gate_rule: Evaluate visible conditions; visible failed comparison wins over unknown prerequisites. Otherwise unknown prerequisites -> unknown, else passed. Scalar reason first in selected list; structural overlap/invalid identity remains error. Future knowledge is failed only when it is a directly evaluated active required fact or proof, never irrelevant future-effective rows.
frozen_quality_projection.numerical_coverage: For each numerical scalar expected/observed count its exact required field/slot population; zero-denominator/no-price statuses are independent from aggregate totals. Context declarations do not invent observed market completeness. Full metadata/source/known-at/evidence/config identity parity is required beyond numeric tolerance.

frozen_action_quantity: apply_factors expects actual raw representation and actual raw_shares source basis; output policy may request split_shares and accepted utility transforms explicitly. caller_transformed expects actual caller_transformed and source quantity exactly requested output quantity basis. Gates do not apply factors and do not add a dividend twice. A requested transformed split-share output does not imply incoming raw volume was already split-adjusted.
frozen_proof_interval_rule: Every source representation/quantity, classification history/projection and action history/projection proof has a positive finite interval, original known_at<=K, and covers its selected effective query or required entire history scope. Source representation/quantity cover every selected market observation effective time and the declared target scope. Missing/late/expired proof is unknown, present wrong-target/source/revision is typed identity error. No inference from source snapshot or row count alone.
